blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Scott Creek. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Scott Creek, Coquitlam: 4 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 25% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 16 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Scott Creek was 2 in June and 4 in October, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall, and 4 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.1% of Coquitlam’s 378 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Scott Creek?
Scott Creek also had 7 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in October, against 4 houses listed. The Scott Creek condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Scott Creek home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

12 houses sold in Scott Creek with a median price of $1,526,500 (the middle half sold between $1,306,250 and $1,670,000), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 96.5% of the last list price; 25% sold above list. They had a median $436 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median lot of 6,022 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Scott Creek?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 4 houses listed in Scott Creek. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Scott Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Scott Creek had a sales ratio of 25% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Scott Creek from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 4 houses sold in Scott Creek over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Scott Creek?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Scott Creek sell for?
faq.a: 12 houses sold in Scott Creek between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,526,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Scott Creek?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.5% of the last list price (25% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
